playstyle: Five Chaos marauders with modest health and single-dodge saves, the Reavers are a straightforward melee warband with no warscroll of their own, borrowing a generic Chaos one instead. Every fighter gains a hex of Move and sharper weapons when Inspired: Saek's heavy hammer gains Cleave, Karsus strikes from two hexes away and Arnulf lands Grievous criticals. Inspiration comes from either killing enemies or outnumbering them in neutral territory. The warband wins by flooding the centre and trading blows aggressively, snowballing kills into stronger attacks.
